curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a routine errand collateralizes an American government experiment, an ordinary cop must discover how to wield powers he never asked for.
curatedMovie.description: While delivering a simple parking ticket in the Florida Everglades, police officer Dave Speed wanders into a secret radiation test where an exploding missile unexpectedly grants him an array of superhuman abilities.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, fast-paced, and playfully absurd, offering breezily exciting comic-book antics ideal for casual group viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Sergio Corbucci, this action-comedy turns a routine police patrol into an energetic sci-fi romp powered by pure early-eighties charm and high-concept fantasy fun.
